text: No, the land-change method could not evaluate this property. While the engine (TerraUY land-change) was set up with parameters like a baseline date of December 31, 2020, and a minimum event area of 0.5 hectares, the analysis failed because the required satellite imagery coverage for the asset was not available. The error message confirms that "the source coverage this asset needs has not been prepared," meaning no observation was made. Thus, no land-change assessment was possible for this property.
